required_patterns.component-structure: React functional components with TypeScript interfaces for props
required_patterns.styling: CSS modules with .module.css pattern for component-specific styles
required_patterns.state-management: Jotai atoms for global state, local useState for component state
required_patterns.canvas-rendering: Canvas components extend InteractiveCanvas/StaticCanvas base classes

architectural_constraints.component-organization: Components must be organized by feature/domain in packages/excalidraw/components/
architectural_constraints.prop-interfaces: All component props must have TypeScript interfaces defined
architectural_constraints.accessibility: Components must include ARIA labels and accessibility attributes
architectural_constraints.theming: Components must support both light and dark themes via CSS variables

required_patterns.canvas-abstraction: Use StaticCanvas for non-interactive rendering, InteractiveCanvas for user interactions
required_patterns.roughjs-integration: All shape rendering must use RoughJS library for hand-drawn aesthetic
required_patterns.coordinate-systems: Use GlobalPoint/LocalPoint types from packages/math for coordinate transformations
required_patterns.rendering-pipeline: Scene rendering through renderScene function with element batching

architectural_constraints.performance: Canvas operations must be optimized for large numbers of elements
architectural_constraints.coordinate-precision: All coordinates must maintain precision through zoom/pan operations
architectural_constraints.export-compatibility: Rendered elements must be exportable to SVG/PNG formats
architectural_constraints.collaboration-sync: Canvas state must be serializable for real-time collaboration

required_patterns.jotai-atoms: Use Jotai atoms for granular reactive state management
required_patterns.app-state: Central appState atom contains all canvas and UI state
required_patterns.action-dispatching: State mutations through action dispatchers following flux pattern
required_patterns.history-management: Undo/redo through history atoms and state snapshots

architectural_constraints.immutability: All state updates must be immutable
architectural_constraints.serialization: State must be JSON serializable for persistence and collaboration
architectural_constraints.performance: State updates must be granular to avoid unnecessary re-renders
architectural_constraints.validation: State mutations must validate data integrity

required_patterns.point-system: Use Point interface and related geometric utilities from packages/math
required_patterns.transformation-matrices: Matrix operations for rotation, scaling, translation
required_patterns.collision-detection: Hit testing and element intersection algorithms
required_patterns.curve-algorithms: Bezier curves and smooth drawing calculations

architectural_constraints.precision: Mathematical operations must maintain floating-point precision
architectural_constraints.performance: Algorithms must be optimized for real-time canvas interactions
architectural_constraints.coordinate-systems: Must handle both global and local coordinate transformations
architectural_constraints.geometric-integrity: Shape operations must preserve geometric relationships

required_patterns.element-interfaces: All drawable elements implement ExcalidrawElement interface
required_patterns.element-types: Specific element types (rectangle, ellipse, arrow, etc.) with type-specific properties
required_patterns.element-mutations: Element updates through action dispatchers maintaining immutability
required_patterns.element-serialization: Elements must be JSON serializable for export/import

architectural_constraints.type-safety: Element operations must maintain TypeScript type safety
architectural_constraints.backwards-compatibility: Element schema must support version migration
architectural_constraints.performance: Element operations must scale with large numbers of elements
architectural_constraints.collaboration: Element changes must support operational transformation

required_patterns.action-definitions: Actions defined in packages/excalidraw/actions/ with standardized structure
required_patterns.action-registration: Actions registered through actionManager with keyboard shortcuts
required_patterns.state-mutations: Actions receive and return updated appState immutably
required_patterns.action-composition: Complex operations composed of multiple atomic actions

architectural_constraints.immutability: Actions must not mutate input state directly
architectural_constraints.reversibility: Actions must support undo/redo through history system
architectural_constraints.validation: Actions must validate preconditions before execution
architectural_constraints.collaboration: Actions must be serializable for real-time collaboration

required_patterns.real-time-sync: Socket.io for real-time collaboration with conflict resolution
required_patterns.operational-transform: CRDT-like approach for merging concurrent edits
required_patterns.presence-awareness: User cursor positions and selection states

architectural_constraints.latency-tolerance: System must handle network delays gracefully
architectural_constraints.offline-support: Local changes must sync when connection restored
architectural_constraints.data-consistency: Collaborative state must remain consistent across clients
architectural_constraints.scalability: System must support multiple concurrent users

required_patterns.local-storage: Browser localStorage for user preferences and recent files
required_patterns.export-formats: JSON, PNG, SVG export through standardized export utilities
required_patterns.import-handling: File import through drag-drop and file picker
required_patterns.library-persistence: Component library stored in localStorage with sync

architectural_constraints.format-compatibility: Export formats must maintain cross-platform compatibility
architectural_constraints.version-migration: File format must support schema evolution
architectural_constraints.size-optimization: Exported files must be optimized for size

required_patterns.i18next-integration: i18next for translation management with namespaces
required_patterns.translation-keys: Structured translation keys following domain hierarchy
required_patterns.rtl-support: Right-to-left language support for UI layout
required_patterns.locale-detection: Automatic locale detection with fallback to English

architectural_constraints.translation-coverage: All user-facing text must be translatable
architectural_constraints.pluralization: Support for plural forms in different languages
architectural_constraints.performance: Translation loading must not block UI rendering

required_patterns.vitest-framework: Vitest for unit and integration testing
required_patterns.test-organization: Tests colocated with source files using .test.ts pattern
required_patterns.mock-utilities: Shared mock utilities for common test scenarios

architectural_constraints.test-coverage: Critical paths must have comprehensive test coverage
architectural_constraints.test-isolation: Tests must not depend on external state
architectural_constraints.performance: Test suite must execute quickly for development workflow
architectural_constraints.maintainability: Tests must be maintainable alongside code changes
